breakdowns.site: Palsana Project Site & JK Paper Unit — 3-Ton Warehouse Forklift Side Shifter Absence & Toyota Mast Friction Damage
breakdowns.issue: (1) A 3-ton forklift dispatched from the warehouse to the Palsana site went without PRC forks and side shifter, paralyzing operations and triggering recurring client escalations. (2) At the JK Paper site, a Toyota forklift mast is rubbing and severely cutting into metal during travel ('ragad ke chal raha hai, cut gaya hai'), risking catastrophic mast shearing if operated further.
breakdowns.action: Store and service teams mobilized to dismantle the mast and side shifter assembly from an older decommissioned unit. Dedicated workshop boys assigned to clean, chemically treat, and service the mast prior to shipping. Due to steep third-party freight quotes, Umesh and transport desk were instructed to measure exact dimensions and gross weight immediately to contract a dedicated vehicle.
breakdowns.logistics: Dedicated transport vehicle required for heavy mast and shifter assembly; dimensions and weight being finalized for booking.
breakdowns.status: Urgent Mobilization — Mast Servicing & Cleaning Underway; Dimensions/Weight Required for Dedicated Vehicle Booking

breakdowns.site: Hyderabad Fleet Operations — Genie 45/25 Articulated Boom Lift Front Axle Severe Oil Leakage
breakdowns.issue: A Genie boom lift (Model 45/25 / 45/50 series) deployed at Hyderabad has been operating with a severe front axle oil seal leak for over 15 days. The site operator tied a cloth around the front axle hub to absorb oil and kept the machine running ('kapda bandh ke operator chala raha hai, 15 din se zyada ho gaya'). Continuing to run the machine risks catastrophic wheel bearing seizure, differential failure, and major safety hazards.
breakdowns.action: Serial number verification prioritized with Ravi Tiwari. Emergency order and dispatch of front axle oil seals and hub rebuild kit initiated; operator instructed to halt hazardous running immediately pending technician overhaul.
breakdowns.status: Critical Mechanical Alert — 15-Day Chronic Axle Leakage; Serial Number Verification & Emergency Seal Replacement Initiated

breakdowns.site: Central Fleet Yard / Sardarji External Workshop — 3-Ton Crane Motor Overhaul & Cylinder Clamp Plates
breakdowns.issue: A 3-ton transport crane vehicle has remained immobilized for 3 days awaiting return of its drive/hydraulic motor sent out for rewinding to Sardarji's workshop. Cylinder mounting plates and clamp assemblies were also removed for machining (Rs 200 plate repair + clamp fitment). Operational follow-up stalled due to lack of direct coordination with the vendor.
breakdowns.action: Management acquired vendor direct contact to follow up immediately with Sardarji, expedite motor rewinding assembly, inspect clamp plates, and complete vehicle remounting today.
breakdowns.status: Immobilized 3 Days — Motor at Rewinding Workshop; Clamp Plates in Machining; Direct Vendor Escalation Initiated

breakdowns.site: Noida Sector 143 Fleet — Genie Electric Scissor Lift (2940/3240 Class) Battery Bank Voltage Collapse & Chemistry Mismatch
breakdowns.issue: Scissor lift at Sector 143 experienced recurring tripping and voltage collapse to 2.5V–3.0V under load after full charging. Technical inspection revealed an improper chemistry mix: 3 AGM batteries paired with 1 conventional lead-acid battery, charged via an incompatible heavy-duty charger. These batteries were secondhand units transferred from Mumbai after servicing 23+ sites and have completed their useful lifecycle. Replacing only 1 or 2 batteries will quickly degrade new cells due to imbalance.
breakdowns.action: Technical leadership (Shiv Uniyal) mandated replacing the entire bank of 4 batteries with a brand-new, matched AGM battery set rather than piecemeal replacement. Charger settings/model to be verified to match AGM charging curves.
breakdowns.status: Operational Stoppage — Battery Bank Imbalance (3 AGM + 1 Lead Acid); Full 4-Battery AGM Replacement Approved

breakdowns.site: Central Warehouse & Depot Operations — Battery Fleet Registry Audit & Scrap Battery Fire Hydrant Clearance
breakdowns.issue: (1) Fleet operations experiencing recurring battery shortages (7 active units running, Unit #16 battery repeatedly failing; minimum 2 new batteries urgently requested). Field managers failed to submit comprehensive serial numbers and commissioning dates. (2) Scrap dead batteries accumulated at depot are stacked near the fire safety pipeline. Scrap recyclers are stalling collection due to dropping scrap lead prices in Delhi NCR. Fire safety inspectors are conducting frequent rounds and issuing strict notices against pipeline obstruction.
breakdowns.action: Central store ordered an immediate mandatory battery registry (logging brand, serial number, commission date, and machine number for all 6-7 batteries in service) before releasing new stock. Scrap vendor instructed to lift old batteries immediately regardless of current scrap market rates to eliminate fire compliance violations.
breakdowns.status: Compliance & Asset Alert — Battery Registry Mandated; Scrap Lead Price Drop Stalling Pickup; Urgent Fire Line Clearance Ordered

breakdowns.site: Bhatinda Project Site & Multi-Depot Fleet — Digital Load Cell Delivery Freeze Over Vendor Payment Stoppage
breakdowns.issue: Digital load cell sensor packages earmarked for 4 machines at Bhatinda and additional depots remain frozen. The vendor has refused to dispatch sensors without advance payment clearance following the expiry of earlier agreement terms. Project team was forced to manually generate calibration certificates because vendor support ceased.
breakdowns.action: Accounts desk (Dhruv Sharma / Mishra Ji) instructed to immediately release approved supplier funds to clear vendor deadlock and secure urgent dispatch of the 4 Bhatinda load cells.
breakdowns.status: Commercial Standoff — 4 Load Cells Withheld by Vendor; Expired Agreement; Accounts Payment Release Escalated

breakdowns.site: Field Diagnostics & Fleet Electronic Troubleshooting — Laptop Retention & Post-Departure Machine Breakdowns
breakdowns.issue: Critical diagnostic programming laptop was retained by technician Parveen for over a week to a month without systematic utilization. Immediately upon his departure from site, equipment suffered breakdown. Another machine at Folder/Dozotikka reported electronic control faults right after technician movement, requiring laptop redeployment.
breakdowns.action: Mandated strict protocol for centralized diagnostic laptop handovers. Diagnostic kit to be retrieved and mobilized immediately to scan and rectify electronic fault codes on the grounded unit.
breakdowns.status: Diagnostic Equipment Coordination — Laptop Redeployment Required for Post-Departure Breakdowns; Turnover Protocol Enforced

breakdowns.site: Kochi Project Site — Operational Machine Hydraulic Line Burst
breakdowns.issue: A heavy hydraulic pressure hose ruptured on an operational machine deployed at the Kochi site, grounding the platform.
breakdowns.action: Site operator mobilized to remove the ruptured hydraulic pipe locally and coordinate rapid crimping or replacement to avoid transit wait times from central store.
breakdowns.status: Breakdown Under Repair — Hydraulic Pipe Ruptured; Local Operator Mobilized for Removal and Hose Crimping

breakdowns.status: Entry Authorization Pending — Security Email Submitted; Approval Expected by Evening; Fitters & Calibration Kits on Standby

directives.title: Strict Prohibition of Mixing Battery Chemistries & Full Bank Replacement Rule
points: Prohibition of Mixed Chemistries: Technicians must never mix AGM (Absorbent Glass Mat) and flooded Lead-Acid batteries in the same battery bank (as observed at Noida Sector 143). Differences in internal resistance and charging profiles lead to rapid cell destruction, severe voltage sag, and charger malfunction.

Complete Bank Replacement: When traction batteries have completed extensive field service (such as multi-site Bombay fleet units), replace all 4 batteries simultaneously. Piecemeal replacement of 1-2 batteries will destroy new batteries within weeks.

directives.title: Mandatory Central Battery Registry & Fleet Asset Tracking
points: Comprehensive Battery Audit: Central store and site supervisors must maintain a complete battery log recording battery brand, model, serial numbers, commissioning date, and assigned machine serial number for all operational units before requisitioning replacements.

Scrap Disposal Compliance: Scrap and condemned batteries must never be stored near fire hydrant lines or emergency exits. Scrap dealers must be mobilized immediately to prevent statutory fire safety non-compliance.

directives.title: Pre-Dispatch Dimensional & Weight Assessment for Heavy Consignments
points: Logistics Planning: Bulky assemblies such as forklift masts, counterweights, and side shifters must be measured for precise dimensional envelope (L x W x H) and gross weight before booking transport to optimize freight costs and eliminate transporter refusal.
Workshop Quality Check: Decommissioned parts salvaged for reuse must undergo thorough chemical cleaning, rust removal, and functional inspection by designated workshop staff before outbound dispatch.

directives.title: Resolution Protocol for Commercial Vendor Payment Deadlocks
points: Timely Vendor Fund Release: Critical safety and diagnostic components (such as Bhatinda digital load cells) must not be stalled due to administrative payment delays; finance desk must prioritize vendor clearances on scheduled payment cycles.

Diagnostic Equipment Custody: Diagnostic laptops and OEM calibration adapters are shared corporate assets and must not be retained by individual technicians for extended periods without management clearance.
